title: Mid-semester break notice
message: Classes will be suspended from the 14th to the 18th for the mid-semester break. Regular schedule resumes the following Monday.

title: Library timings extended for exam week
message: The central library will stay open until 11 PM starting next week to support exam preparation.

title: Placement drive registration open
message: Third and fourth year students can register for the upcoming campus placement drive through the placement cell.

title: Sports day schedule released
message: The annual sports day schedule is now available. Event registration closes this Friday.

title: Fee payment deadline reminder
message: Second installment fees are due by the end of this month. Pay early to avoid late payment charges.

title: Guest lecture on cybersecurity
message: An industry expert will deliver a guest lecture on web security fundamentals in the main auditorium.

title: Hostel water supply maintenance
message: Water supply to hostel blocks A and B will be interrupted for maintenance work from 10 AM to 2 PM.

title: Blood donation camp
message: The student council is organizing a voluntary blood donation camp in collaboration with the city hospital.

title: Late fee waiver announced
message: Students who missed the fee deadline due to technical issues can request a late fee waiver from the accounts office.

title: Wi-Fi upgrade this weekend
message: Campus Wi-Fi will be upgraded this Saturday between 1 AM and 5 AM. Brief outages are expected during this window.

title: Alumni meet registrations open
message: Graduating batches from the last five years are invited to register for the annual alumni meet.

title: Internship info session
message: The training and placement cell will hold an information session on summer internship opportunities.

title: Exam datesheet released
message: The end-semester exam datesheet has been published. Students should check their exact slot and hall allocation.

title: Cultural fest volunteer signup
message: Volunteers are needed for the upcoming cultural fest. Sign up at the student activity center by Friday.

title: Scholarship application window open
message: Merit and need-based scholarship applications are now open. Submit documents to the accounts office before the deadline.
